title: The French Revolution: Political Events
text: The French Revolution began with the convening of the Estates-General in May 1789 and the Third Estate's formation of the National Assembly. The storming of the Bastille prison on July 14, 1789 became the symbolic starting point of the revolution. The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen was adopted in August 1789. The monarchy was suspended in August 1792 and abolished in September, with France declared a republic. Louis XVI was tried for treason and executed by guillotine on January 21, 1793. The Committee of Public Safety under Robespierre oversaw the Reign of Terror (September 1793 – July 1794), during which approximately 17,000 people were officially executed.
